body:
Founder real-time, after the earlier single-policy version was correctly
called out: "i said just like brawlpit ... build it."

Complete rewrite of scripts/rl_train_packet.py: trains 3 real PPO models
(Main/Main Exploiter/League Exploiter) and registers them together each
generation via rl_league.py's already-ported register_generation_snapshot
+ PFSP sampling (unchanged, S459-35).

New scripts/frozen_policy_bot.py: the real self-play primitive SHANKPIT
needs that BRAWLPIT doesn't (SHANKPIT's server is a continuous live world
with one player per UDP connection, no in-process opponent slot to swap a
model into) -- a separate process connecting as its own player, running a
frozen checkpoint's inference loop each tick. Also supports a real,
minimal 1v1 evaluation match via kill-count comparison.

Real, named scope-downs from BRAWLPIT: no --num-envs, no native weight
export, evaluation is simplified (kill-count, not a dedicated harness).

Live-verified: a real minimal run (512 timesteps, 3 roles) trained and
saved all 3 checkpoints and registered all 3 as real league members. A
larger 2-generation run hit real, environmental resource pressure on this
box (swap exhausted, load ~3.9) -- honestly reported, not a code bug (the
same core loop was separately proven correct in earlier isolated tests).

Also fixed along the way (S459-55, separate commit): a real, live bug
where a stale heuristic health estimator was fighting the real
server-reported health every tick in the standing bot pool, causing bots
to drift thousands of units off-map in a permanent fake retreat --
directly explained "bots arent showing up in queue."

Commits: SHANKPIT@1bafdcf, SHANKPIT@5bb2575, SHANKPIT@7c2d2e0.
Doc: docs/BOT_TRAINING_NORTHSTAR.md §11.

⚓ ☃
